rounds.text: The business is demonstrating robust compounding capabilities, evidenced by a 29% compounded profit growth over five years and a stellar 71% growth over three years [E17, E18]. Operational efficiency is high, highlighted by cash conversion reaching 6.38x in March 2026 where profits are fully backed by cash [E29], generating Rs 746 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 481 Cr in free cash flow [E30, E31]. Growth drivers are actively scaling, demonstrated by a 17% compounded sales growth in the trailing twelve months alongside strong quarterly metrics [E16, E66]. Capital expenditure is transitioning into productive deployment, as Capital Work in Progress dropped by 81.7% to Rs 15 Cr by March 2026, signaling that new capacity is coming online [E36]. Furthermore, foreign institutional investors have increased their stake from 1.08% in September 2023 to 2.38% in June 2026 [E38], and the stock maintains a healthy relative-strength rating of 79 against the Nifty 500 [E47]. Conceded: the stock trades at a rich P/E of 81.6x alongside negative trailing twelve-month profit growth [E1, E19].
